title: Personal Greetings, Final Instructions and Doxology

questions.question: Paul commends to the Romans our sister Phoebe, a servant of the church at ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 16:1 (ESV): "I commend to you our sister Phoebe, a servant of the church at Cenchreae,"

questions.question: Paul greets Prisca and Aquila, his fellow workers in Christ Jesus, who risked ____ for his life.
questions.explanation: Romans 16:3-4 (ESV): "Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus, who risked their necks for my life,"

questions.question: Who is described as the "first convert to Christ in Asia"?
questions.explanation: Romans 16:5 (ESV): "Greet also the church in their house. Greet my beloved Epaenetus, who was the first convert to Christ in Asia."

questions.question: Paul greets Andronicus and Junia, his kinsmen and fellow prisoners, who were well known to the apostles, and who were in Christ ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 16:7 (ESV): "Greet Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen and my fellow prisoners. They are well known to the apostles, and they were in Christ before me."

questions.question: Greet Rufus, chosen in the Lord; also his mother, who has been ____.
options: a mother to me as well
a faithful servant in the church
questions.correctAnswer: a mother to me as well
questions.explanation: Romans 16:13 (ESV): "Greet Rufus, chosen in the Lord; also his mother, who has been a mother to me as well."

questions.question: After his list of greetings, Paul instructs the Romans to greet one another with a holy ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 16:16 (ESV): "Greet one another with a holy kiss. All the churches of Christ greet you."

questions.question: Paul appeals to them to watch out for those who cause divisions and create obstacles contrary to the doctrine they have been taught, and to ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 16:17 (ESV): "I appeal to you, brothers, to watch out for those who cause divisions and create obstacles contrary to the doctrine that you have been taught; avoid them."

questions.question: For such persons do not serve our Lord Christ, but their own ____, and by smooth talk and flattery they deceive the hearts of the naive.
questions.explanation: Romans 16:18 (ESV): "For such persons do not serve our Lord Christ, but their own appetites, and by smooth talk and flattery they deceive the hearts of the naive."

questions.question: Paul rejoices over their obedience, but he wants them to be wise as to what is good and ____.
options: innocent as to what is evil
questions.correctAnswer: innocent as to what is evil
questions.explanation: Romans 16:19 (ESV): "For your obedience is known to all, so that I rejoice over you, but I want you to be wise as to what is good and innocent as to what is evil."

questions.question: What does Paul promise the God of peace will soon do?
options: Reveal his glorious Son from heaven
questions.explanation: Romans 16:20 (ESV): "The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you."

questions.question: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you; so do Lucius and Jason and Sosipater, my ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 16:21 (ESV): "Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you; so do Lucius and Jason and Sosipater, my kinsmen."

questions.question: Who identifies himself as the one who wrote this letter in the Lord?
questions.explanation: Romans 16:22 (ESV): "I Tertius, who wrote this letter, greet you in the Lord."

questions.question: Gaius, who is host to me and to the whole church, greets you. Erastus, the ____, and our brother Quartus, greet you.
questions.explanation: Romans 16:23 (ESV): "Gaius, who is host to me and to the whole church, greets you. Erastus, the city treasurer, and our brother Quartus, greet you."

questions.question: Now to him who is able to strengthen you according to my gospel and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery that was kept secret for ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 16:25 (ESV): "Now to him who is able to strengthen you according to my gospel and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery that was kept secret for long ages"

questions.question: This mystery has now been disclosed and through the prophetic writings has been made known to all nations, according to the command of the eternal God, to bring about what?
questions.explanation: Romans 16:26 (ESV): "but has now been disclosed and through the prophetic writings has been made known to all nations, according to the command of the eternal God, to bring about the obedience of faith—"

key_verse_text: The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
